name: Gravelly Beach
desc1: This is a gravelly beach, curving around the sheer rock face to the
desc2: north. Bits of shell and bone litter the beach, and if there is any
desc3: plant life, you certainly cannot find it. In fact, there is a
desc4: noticeable lack of life signs throughout this whole area, and you get
desc5: the feeling that even the animals that may have inhabited this island
desc6: have abandoned it. The beach continues to the northeast and southwest.
